node.statement: For every nonzero Z, division by ||Z||^2 gives (||T_n(Z)||/||Z||)^2 >= A*a_n-B. Taking the infimum is legitimate because all ratios are nonnegative and inf r(Z)^2=(inf r(Z))^2=a_n^2; hence a_n^2>=A*a_n-B. Thus (a_n-r_-)(a_n-r_+)>=0, and since r_-<=r_+, one has a_n<=r_- or a_n>=r_+.
